contributor to MP (1887-90)

She offered Good Friday, another story about Ottavia, to MP in 1889; she may have lived abroad.

Both 'Ottavia' MP 1887(2) 87 and 'A Good Friday Procession at Grassina' MP (1890) (1) 371 appeared under the name 'E.Vere'.
